run_NVE_MD_simulation: run an NVE molecular dynamics simulation on atomic structures using VelocityVerlet integrator and LBFGS relaxation
get_thermo_data_from_log: get simulation time and total energy arrays from a thermo log file using get_thermo
load_NVE_MD_dataset: load MD22 or TM23 dataset with atomic structures and temperatures using get_nve_md_data
create_NVEMDRunner_instance: create an NVEMDRunner with a calculator, input data, timestep, steps, and save frequency
parse_MD22_TM23_temperatures: parse MD22 molecule or TM23 metal temperature constants from MD22_TEMP and TM23_TEMP dictionaries
